subject: Request: tokens allocation & 60-day trial extension for Nimbus Labs POC
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@nimbuslabs.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimbus.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC — anticipated TPU/TPM needs + request for extended trial

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding earlier — team is excited to kick off the POC. To be transparent about scope: we plan to run a 6-week evaluation focused on long-context retrieval (up to 150k tokens/session) and multi-step generation that will drive very high tokens-per-minute (TPM) during batch runs. The internal estimate is ~2.1M tokens in week 1 (spiky TPM up to ~12k) and then roughly 1.2–1.5M tokens/week thereafter.

Given those numbers the default PLG credits are going to burn out in a day. Could Redwood provide: 1) a tokens/grant allocation that covers the first 6 weeks, and 2) a 60-day trial extension so we can complete the evaluation? I attached a short requirements spreadsheet (nimbus_poc_requirements.xlsx) with expected batch profiles.

Procurement is cc'd — they will need the billing contact to lock down the commercial pilot if we move forward.

Would appreciate a ballpark on what an appropriate grant would look like from your side so we can plan experiments.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of AI Products
Nimbus Labs

--
Attachment: nimbus_poc_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood POC — anticipated TPU/TPM needs + request for extended trial

Marissa / Mina — forwarding Nimbus' request. Key ask: tokens allocation to cover a heavy 6-week POC (see spreadsheet) + 60-day trial extension. They expect big TPM spikes early on.

Suggested approach from sales ops: propose a token grant equivalent to $20k of hosted credits plus a 60-day extension, with monitoring hooks (we can throttle if misuse). Given the high context windows they might also benefit from our higher-memory instance routing for the heaviest runs — we should flag any Dedicated/burst options in the note.

Questions for approval:
- Approve $20k hosted credit equivalent + 60 days?
- Add condition: usage visibility + auto-notify at 75% burn?

If approved I will send a formal grant + redemption link and add procurement contact to billing.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood POC — anticipated TPU/TPM needs + request for extended trial

Rishi — thanks for the details. A few operational asks before sign-off:
- Can sales ops confirm how we translate $20k into token units for their requested model variants? (We should avoid over/under provisioning.)
- Add a 60-day expiration on the credits from issuance date (not calendar); include a clause that credits are restricted to the Nimbus account only.
- For spikes: we can enable a soft cap at the token level and notify the customer + AEs at 75%. Any override would require manager sign-off.

Assuming we can map to token units and attach monitoring, I am +1 to the $20k grant as a one-time promotional allowance. Mina, can you prepare the monitoring + alerting config?

-Marissa
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Nimbus promotional grant (conditions attached)

Team — after reviewing the POC requirements and potential upside, I approve the promotional grant with the following conditions:
1) Grant amount: $25,000 hosted credit equivalent (to cover higher-context model runs).
2) Trial extension: 60 days from issuance.
3) Monitoring: set up token-level dashboards and a 75% burn alert to the AE + CS. Auto-throttle enabled (soft cap) at 125% of expected weekly throughput — overrides require my approval.
4) Procurement check: require signed NDA (we need a copy in the thread) and a billing contact before any commercial commitments.

Mina: please prepare the monitoring doc and add the alert hooks. Marissa/Rishi: proceed to issue grant only after NDA is uploaded and procurement contact confirmed.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
